sources.title: GitHub - Avicennasis/incorrecter: The opposite of autocorrect: a 0.5B ...
sources.snippet: The opposite of autocorrect. Incorrecter takes clean, AI-sounding text — a thank-you email, a landlord note, a Slack update, a short essay — and adds a few realistic human errors: eggcorns, wrong homophones, fat-finger slips, a lowercase sentence start, a doubled space, a dropped final period.
